fusions.name: Shield Rim
fusions.desc: Drives the rim of your shield into the target for 12 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Clashing Pauldrons
fusions.desc: You throw your plated shoulders outward, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Layer
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage, up to 5 blows, for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 15% while it holds.

fusions.name: Spare Plates
fusions.desc: Conjures a second suit of plate over your own: every hit you take is 3 lower, your armour rises by 12%, your maximum health rises by 12, and 4% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
